pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a good sprinting technique, the elbows are bent to about (1 mark)
   A. a tiny angle
   B. a right angle
   C. a straight line
   D. a full circle

2. When sprinting, where should your eyes look? (1 mark)
   A. At your feet
   B. Behind you
   C. At the sky
   D. Straight ahead

3. Which is a safety rule for sprint races? (1 mark)
   A. Run in any lane
   B. Run backwards
   C. Never push or trip another runner
   D. Push to get ahead

4. In an elongated start, the rear knee is level with (1 mark)
   A. the start line
   B. the toes of the front foot
   C. the front knee
   D. the heel of the front foot

5. What should you do if something hurts during gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Stop and tell your teacher
   B. Push a friend
   C. Keep going
   D. Hide it

6. If your head drops back with a strain in the crab balance, you should (1 mark)
   A. close your mouth tight
   B. throw it back further
   C. keep the head in line and look gently up
   D. hold your breath

7. How can you fix sagging hips in the crab balance? (1 mark)
   A. Drop your head
   B. Bend your arms
   C. Push harder through your hands and feet
   D. Lie down

8. Why is gymnastics described as not being a race? (1 mark)
   A. It uses no body
   B. It is about control and quality, not speed
   C. It cannot be seen
   D. It is always in the dark

9. A patriotic song shows (1 mark)
   A. a rainy day
   B. fear
   C. love for one's country
   D. love of sweets

10. Which folk songs are sung when young people become adults in their community? (1 mark)
   A. Initiation songs
   B. Naming songs
   C. Work songs
   D. Topical songs

11. A sign that narrows to the right means (1 mark)
   A. getting softer
   B. repeat
   C. getting louder
   D. getting faster

12. How should you behave when the anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Talk to friends
   B. Run around
   C. Stand straight and quietly
   D. Play games

13. The word photography comes from words meaning (1 mark)
   A. drawing with paint
   B. drawing with light
   C. writing with ink
   D. drawing with sound

14. Indoors, the best place to stand for better light is (1 mark)
   A. under a table
   B. in the cupboard
   C. in a dark corner
   D. near a window or open door

15. Photography is (1 mark)
   A. the art of taking pictures with a camera
   B. singing songs
   C. painting with a brush
   D. cutting paper

16. When photographing a child, it is good to (1 mark)
   A. stand on a chair
   B. photograph from above only
   C. shout
   D. bend down to their eye level

17. Where is the thumb hole? (1 mark)
   A. On the bell
   B. At the back
   C. Under the foot
   D. On the mouthpiece

18. The song Hot Cross Buns can be played on (1 mark)
   A. B A G
   B. C D E only
   C. only drums
   D. only G and C

19. Why keep a recorder away from strong sun and fire? (1 mark)
   A. It becomes invisible
   B. It becomes lighter
   C. The sun makes it sing
   D. Heat can bend it

20. Covering more finger holes makes the note (1 mark)
   A. higher
   B. silent
   C. louder always
   D. lower

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. What is a side roll? (2 marks)

22. Describe the position of the back knee in the medium start and in the elongated start. (3 marks)

23. State three points to check when giving feedback to a friend playing the recorder. (3 marks)

24. How should we behave towards the national flag? (3 marks)

25. Describe a sequence that joins the crab balance and the side roll, and how to perform it safely. (5 marks)

26. Give three common mistakes in the crab balance and how to fix them. (3 marks)

27. Explain why covering more holes makes a lower note. (3 marks)

28. What is a sequence in gymnastics? Give an example. (3 marks)

29. What is a false start? (2 marks)

30. Why do we get up slowly after a side roll? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — a right angle
   Bent arms swinging back and forth help the stride.

2. D — Straight ahead
   Keeping the head up and eyes ahead helps balance and speed.

3. C — Never push or trip another runner
   Pushing or tripping can hurt people.

4. D — the heel of the front foot
   The elongated start puts the knee further back, by the heel of the front foot.

5. A — Stop and tell your teacher
   Pain is a warning, so stop and tell the teacher.

6. C — keep the head in line and look gently up
   Keep the head in line with the body.

7. C — Push harder through your hands and feet
   Pushing through hands and feet lifts the hips.

8. B — It is about control and quality, not speed
   Skill and control matter more than speed.

9. C — love for one's country
   Patriotic songs celebrate the nation.

10. A — Initiation songs
   Initiation songs mark the change from child to adult.

11. A — getting softer
   A closing sign means the music grows softer.

12. C — Stand straight and quietly
   An anthem is sung with respect.

13. B — drawing with light
   Photography means drawing with light.

14. D — near a window or open door
   Daylight helps.

15. A — the art of taking pictures with a camera
   A photograph is a picture taken by a camera.

16. D — bend down to their eye level
   Eye level gives a friendly picture.

17. B — At the back
   The left thumb covers the hole at the back.

18. A — B A G
   It uses the three notes B, A and G.

19. D — Heat can bend it
   Heat can warp or crack the instrument.

20. D — lower
   More holes covered gives a longer air column, so a lower note.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: A roll along the mat sideways with the body straight and long like a log.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sideways roll, 1 mark for the straight body.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the medium start, the back knee is level with the middle of the front foot. In the elongated start it is level with the heel of the front foot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each position, 1 mark for saying the elongated start is further back.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Correct notes, steady rhythm and rests, clear tone without squeaks, good posture. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not let it touch the ground, do not write on it, keep it clean and not torn, and stand still and quiet when it is raised.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: Warm up and use a mat with a clear space. Do a crab balance and hold for three counts. Lower to the mat and lie straight with arms overhead. Do a side roll in a straight line. Get up slowly and finish standing tall.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for safety, crab balance, lowering, roll, and finish.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hips sagging: push harder. Bent arms: straighten them. Head dropped: keep it in line.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mistake with a fix.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: The column of air inside becomes longer, and a longer air column vibrates more slowly, giving a lower note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for longer air column, 2 marks for lower note.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: A set of movements done in a fixed order. For example crab balance, lower to the mat, lie straight, side roll.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for the correct example.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Leaving the start line before the last signal is given.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for leaving early, 1 mark for before the signal.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Getting up fast can make you feel dizzy and you may fall. Slowly is safer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dizziness, 1 mark for falling, 1 mark for safety.
